title: Bound on the binary list encoding
statement: For every finite Boolean list $w$, the natural number whose base-two digits are the bits of $w$ followed by a terminal digit $1$ is less than $2^{|w|+1}$, where $|w|$ is the length of $w$.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite list of Booleans
